record_reviews.summary: The 66-block preserved source contains the second 18 November 1858 memorial to the Chancellor of the Exchequer, preceded by editorial appendix material and the first anti-severance memorial. The signed naturalists propose separate popular, scientific and economic museums, dedicated libraries, and coordinated Kew/British Museum botanical collections; the signatory list includes Darwin, Huxley, Henslow, Lindley, Carpenter and others. This is a collective institutional document with Darwin's signature, not a one-to-one letter or synthetic Darwin monologue.
